📅 Slate Headlines + Flags

What is this? The top storylines for tonight's slate — where to stack, what to fade, and where the value is. Start here every day. Each card has a color-coded action tag and a link to the relevant board.
🔥
🔥 TOP PARK · STACK

Angel Stadium +5% HR — slate's top HR environment

ATH @ LAA (9:38 ET). Top bats here: Mike Trout (49). Park also +1% Runs.

→ See HR Board for these bats
🔥
STACK

TOR stack vs Carlos Rodón (V64 — slate-worst starter)

Yankee Stadium -12% HR. HR Board: Kazuma Okamoto #1 (Score 70, ⚡7), Daulton Varsho #3 (Score 65, ⚡5), Jesús Sánchez #4 (Score 65, ⚡4), Brandon Valenzuela #9 (Score 60, ⚡4). Best same-game stack of the slate.

→ HR Board
🎯
STACK

ARI stack vs Zach Agnos (V57)

Chase Field -11% HR. HR Board: Corbin Carroll #5 (Score 65), Nolan Arenado #6 (Score 62), Ketel Marte #7 (Score 62). Cross-game complement to the top stack.

→ HR Board
⚡
STRIKEOUT (K) TARGET

Strikeout leader: Jose Soriano 6.4 K — Best Line: O 5+

LAA vs ATH. Braxton Ashcraft 5.3 K (O 5+) is slate #2. Rule: ≥5 K → O5+, 4.5–4.99 → O3.5, <4.5 → O2.5. Never alt above 5 strikeouts.

→ Full K's Board
☢️
HR RISK · STACK OPPS

Pitcher's HR Risk Board: stack opponents on these arms

Luis Severino 0.88 HR/9 (vs LAA, V43). All have HR-stack potential.

→ Pitcher's HR Risk Board
🥶
FADE HR ALTS

HR suppressed at 3 parks — fade HR alts

Comerica Park -34% HR (CLE @ DET) / Busch Stadium -26% HR (PIT @ STL) / Nationals Park -24% HR (NYM @ WAS). Fade HR alts — pivot to 1+H / RBI / Runs plays. Chase Field +18% 2B/3B — pivot to doubles props there.

→ Park Factors Board
⛔
SKIP K PROPS

1 arm below the strikeout floor — don't bet K props

Zach Agnos (COL, K 1.5). All below the O 2.5 alt floor. Avoid strikeout props on these arms entirely.

→ Daily Skip List
